simple.meaning: צִינֹק (tsîynôq) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “the pillory.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 1 time across Jeremiah, beginning at Jeremiah 29:26. Its contexts include priesthood, prophetic witness.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to צִינֹק (H6729).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.

firstOccurrence.englishText: “Yahweh has made you priest in the place of Jehoiada the priest, that there may be officers in Yahweh’s house, for every man who is crazy, and makes himself a prophet, that you should put him in the stocks and in shackles.
